references.role: 三川殿前瓦面與石構；支持同一屋坡材料延伸，不能證明每一背面。
中殿重簷可見瓦坡；只比對既有可分離瓦皮。
後殿室內與局部簷下；燈光影響，不能作整屋面或牆面的日光色證。
鐘鼓樓既有瓦坡與兩側可見側廊瓦面；綠門及多色雕飾不套到粗模型。
Rear-hall exterior shows orange-family tile rows. The old image has a green/yellow cast; used only as tile-family corroboration, never a measured current color.
寺方文字說明三川殿背面為開放式對看廳、沒有牆壁隔間。模型封閉粗牆與真實構法不符，因此不刷色掩蓋。
references.use: architectural limitation only; unviewed page images not used as color evidence

geometry_scope: Same original 14,620 vertices and 29,236 triangles; no geometry revision.

change.front_and_central_halls: 4,721 originally neutral complete tile-skin facets assigned existing orange tile material using the original heightfield at every triangle vertex; exact original front material assignments retained.
change.towers: 270 originally neutral whole sloping facets assigned existing same-shell orange tile material; top finials, vertical walls and decorative rods stay neutral.
change.side_galleries: 1,483 original gallery tile-skin facets, separately matched to original rotated 24x24 heightfields, receive same tile family inferred from official-7 visible neighboring roofs.
change.wall_paint: No wall-paint extension. Real open colonnades do not map reliably to the old fused closed-wall abstraction.
change.rear_hall: 6,892 original rear-hall roof-skin facets assigned the existing tile family by same-building inference. The temple guide photograph f563fed2 captioned 1998 shows orange-family tile rows; color cast and age prohibit exact present-day color claims.
change.other_neutrals: Crests, relief/decorative coarse blocks, roof solid closures, horizontal fusion patches, unknown walls, base and landscaping unchanged.

limits: Same-component continuity and gallery-family inference are explicitly estimated, not a measured or fully photographed present-day reconstruction.
Original palette labels, RGBA, Principled Base Color and roughness 0.72 are retained. Their historical front/unknown names describe provenance, not the new full material face selection.
No invented green eave bands, dragons, painted panel boundaries, new door/window finishes or facial detail.
Sources contain no verified color calibration; older undated photographs do not establish current paint condition.
Original photographs remain private and are absent from the publication manifest.
supersedes: New facade-continuity scope supplements the earlier front-only COLOR-SOURCE-REGISTER.json, which remains historical evidence; its old no-rear inference scope no longer describes the updated selected roof facets.
